text:
maria-ghosh: Heads-up — finalizing SEO checklist for next week's webinar + launch post. Need redirects, anchor-text mapping, JSON-LD schema for the landing, canonical strategy, and inbound lead routing to SDR queue. Who can own each piece? :calendar: 

samir-cho: I can own canonical + cluster reuse. Question — do we canonicalize the benchmark blog to the main benchmark hub or the new launch post? Prefer hub unless content is substantially new.

jess-lee: I'll own the launch post content + internal links. Shared draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketing/webinar-launch-draft (comments welcome). Also created a quick redirect CSV we can hand to ops.

alex-ng: I can do redirects + nginx PR. Post the CSV format and I'll run through with ops. ETA EOD Tue.

jess-lee: Redirect CSV (sample):
```
old_path,new_path,code,notes,owner
/blog/benchmarks/q1-2025,/blog/benchmarks/2026-q1-benchmark,301,merge content to new benchmarks hub,maria-ghosh
/webinar/old-landing,/webinar/webinar-2026-q1,302,temp holding page until publish,alex-ng
/product/quickstart,/docs/get-started,301,consolidate docs,jess-lee
```

simon (note: not in participants): we should avoid 302s for long-term redirects. use 301 unless temporary.

seo-bot: Reminder — run schema validation against staging before publish. JSON-LD checklist: @type WebPage, mainEntity (FAQ schema if we have 3+ Qs), breadcrumbList, and speakable if using audio. Validator: https://schema.redwood.tools/validate

samir-cho: For canonical: set rel=canonical to /blog/benchmarks/2026-q1 on the launch post and add link rel="alternate" hreflang if we localize. Also add internal anchor mapping on the hub to the launch post for keyword flow (target phrase: "LLM inference cost benchmarks").

jess-lee: On the webinar landing — we'll add hidden fields on the form for campaign=webinar-2026-q1 and source=launch-email. Also append UTM for social links. Team: confirm UTM convention is utm_source=organic|email|paid, utm_campaign=webinar-2026-q1.

alex-ng: Ops note: when I push nginx redirects, I'll add a test harness and a smoke curl script. Example test command: `curl -I https://redwood.com/blog/benchmarks/q1-2025` should return 301 Location header.

samir-cho: Inbound routing — map webinar leads to SFDC campaign "Webinar Q1 2026" and queue to SDR team webinar-sdr. Webhook path: POST https://hooks.redwood.com/marketing/leads -> include lead.source, utm_campaign, webinar_id. Jess, can you add a note in the form integration?

jess-lee: Yep, will add fields and send test payloads to staging. Will ping when ready.

maria-ghosh: Action items (owners + due):
- Redirect CSV final review (jess + alex) — due Mon 09:00 PT
- Nginx PR + smoke tests (alex) — due Tue EOD
- Schema JSON-LD draft + validator pass (samir) — due Tue 12:00 PT
- Form fields + webhook test (jess) — due Tue 15:00 PT
- Inbound routing config in SFDC (samir -> ops) — due Wed

alex-ng: I'll drop the PR link here when ready.

jess-lee: PR for content copy edits incoming. Also adding anchor text map in the draft — short phrases only, avoid exact-match spam.

seo-bot: Tip: run Lighthouse SEO audit on the staging landing after schema is added. Expect to fix 1-2 accessibility flags.

maria-ghosh: Perfect. If we hit blockers, flag here and we'll escalate to growth. Otherwise let's aim to freeze assets by Wed so we can schedule the publish. :rocket:
